title: YD. Exact finite prime discount
milestone_description: For arbitrary finite natural valuations v_i,a_i and real weights w_i, prove the exact identity sum_i (v_i-2a_i)_+ w_i + sum_i min((11a_i-v_i)_+,9a_i) w_i = 9 sum_i a_i w_i + sum_i (v_i-11a_i)_+ w_i. The linked Lean proof covers this abstract finite identity only; the concrete zeta(9) substitution is local mathematical work.
